Source: https://github.com/storytold/soundcraft
Commit: 52471b37e957feaea56dfd48932ef16d314cc74a
License: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (license texts included in each crate)

soundcraft-vst3-host: host sources and test fixture imported from crates/vst3-host.
soundcraft-au-host: AUv2 effect host imported from crates/au-host at the same commit;
locally extended to AUv2/AUv3 effects and adapted to fallible DSP, queued parameters,
stopped-worker property refresh, bounded state and a generic parameter controller.
Native Cocoa view hosting and AUEventListener integration are local adaptations;
view/unit lifetime follows the helper's stopped-worker and UI-thread teardown.
Optional AU OfflineRender notification, stopped-unit transitions and persistent
failure after an unsuccessful rollback are local additions. Dedicated auol units
requiring a priming/preflight lifecycle remain excluded.
AUv3 uses Apple's documented AudioComponentInstantiate and RequestViewController
C compatibility bridge. Bounded main-runloop waits, late-result retirement,
retained view controllers and distinct au3: identities are local additions.
No private AUAudioUnit property/getter or 64-bit parameter-address cast is used.
API reference:
https://developer.apple.com/documentation/audiotoolbox/hosting-audio-unit-extensions-using-the-auv2-api
soundcraft-dsp: only the plugin interfaces and data types from crates/dsp/src/lib.rs;
built-in DSP, application, editor and DAW engine implementations are excluded.

Local adaptations: descriptor-based explicit loading; fallible processor configuration
and processing; normalized parameter delivery without controller calls on the audio
thread; host message/attribute COM objects; hidden/bypass parameter and preset refresh
synchronization; controlled process lifecycle and error propagation; macOS helper event-loop
and autorelease scopes; Linux X11/XEmbed windows and per-context/frame IRunLoop ownership.
VST3 realtime/offline setup and process modes, same-instance stopped mode changes,
and isolated processing-mode fixture contracts are local adaptations. Mode setup
and bus negotiation run on the helper control/UI thread.
Timing readers, lifecycle flags shared with the worker and an atomic latency/tail
pair are local additions. SDK timing queries and latency-change reactivation run
on the creating control thread while the application suspends DSP. Getter-raised
notifications remain pending; failed transitions prevent further processing.
Application integrations
are maintained in native/audio-host, not in the upstream FFI implementation.

native/vst2-host is a local effect adapter. Its ABI declarations reference the
MIT-licensed RustAudio/vst-rs source; the corresponding notice is included in
native/vst2-host/THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.txt. No Steinberg SDK headers are distributed.
